# StayInLapland

> Settle into Finnish Lapland: cabin rentals by the week, design hotels in Rovaniemi and Saariselkä, and Lapland glass igloos.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://stayinlapland.com/): Where to stay in Finnish Lapland
- [Long stays](https://stayinlapland.com/long-stays/): Weekly and monthly stays, serviced apartments and cabins
- [Hotels](https://stayinlapland.com/hotels/): Hotels across Finnish Lapland
- [Glass igloos](https://stayinlapland.com/glass-igloos/): Glass igloo stays in Lapland
- [Wilderness](https://stayinlapland.com/wilderness/): Wilderness lodges and remote stays
- [Booking guide](https://stayinlapland.com/booking-guide/): How and when to book Lapland accommodation
- [When to go](https://stayinlapland.com/when-to-go/): Seasons in Finnish Lapland
- [Rovaniemi](https://stayinlapland.com/destinations/rovaniemi/): Where to stay in Rovaniemi
- [Levi](https://stayinlapland.com/destinations/levi/): Where to stay in Levi
- [Inari](https://stayinlapland.com/destinations/inari/): Where to stay in Inari

## Languages

English (default), Finnish (/fi/), Swedish (/sv/), German (/de/), French (/fr/), Spanish (/es/), Italian (/it/), Dutch (/nl/), Japanese (/ja/), Brazilian Portuguese (/br/), Chinese (/cn/), Korean (/kr/)
